site_lede: Interactive essays: ideas that make more sense when you can touch them.
site_intro: Each explorable teaches one idea by letting you play with it. Change a number, drag a control, and see what happens. No formulas to memorise: the text asks a question and the interactive model lets you answer it.
dinero_description: Enter your salary and see, euro by euro, how much income tax (IRPF) takes and why. Coming soon: how that has changed over the years and how you compare with everyone else.
inspiration: Inspired by Bret Victor's explorable explanations and the explorabl.es collection.
